test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined phrase.

She can't __make up her mind__ where to go for her summer vacation.

options.text: Decide between alternatives or come to a decision
Decide how to do her makeup
Engage her mind in creative activities

solution:
The correct answer is Option 1 i.e. **'Decide between alternatives or come to a decision'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **make up her mind:** A decision between alternatives (मन बनाना)
 
• **Decide between alternatives or come to a decision**: (निर्णय लेना) - To make a choice among options or to reach a conclusion
 
 
• **Example**: She took a long time to **make up her mind** about which college to attend.
 
 
 
• This is the correct answer because the phrase directly relates to reaching a decision or selecting among alternatives.

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Decide between alternatives or come to a decision'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Decide on a suitable parlour:** (सूटेबल पार्लर का चुनाव करना) - To choose a suitable salon or beauty parlour.
 
• **Decide how to do her makeup:** (मेकअप कैसे करें इसका निर्णय लेना) - To choose a makeup look or style.
 
• **Engage her mind in creative activities: **(रचनात्मक गतिविधियों में मन लगाना) - To involve oneself in activities that require creativity.

The correct answer is Option 2 i.e.** "Extravagant".**
